method_card.title: Music and Listening Habits
method_card.content:
This lesson covers music genres, listening habits, instruments and concerts, plus two key grammar structures: comparatives and desde hace + present for ongoing duration.

SpanishEnglish
la músicamusic
la canciónsong
el cantante / la cantantesinger (m/f)
el grupoband / group
el conciertoconcert
el instrumentoinstrument
tocar la guitarrato play the guitar
tocar el pianoto play the piano
escuchar músicato listen to music
el poppop (music)
el rockrock (music)
el raprap
la música clásicaclassical music
relajanterelaxing
animado/alively, upbeat
desde hace + timefor (ongoing duration) — (Higher)

Grammar focus 1 — desde hace + present: Spanish uses the present tense (NOT the perfect) to express an action that started in the past and is still happening. English says 'I have been listening…'; Spanish says escucho (present). Structure: verb (present) + desde hace + time expression. Example: Toco la guitarra desde hace tres años. (I have been playing the guitar for three years.) Escucho música pop desde hace dos años. (I have been listening to pop music for two years.)

Grammar focus 2 — comparatives: más + adjective + que (more … than); menos + adjective + que (less … than). Example: El rock es más emocionante que la música clásica. (Rock is more exciting than classical music.) Irregular: bueno → mejor, malo → peor.

Model paragraph: Escucho música todos los días. Me encanta el pop porque es animado y alegre. Toco la guitarra desde hace cuatro años. En mi opinión, los conciertos en directo son más emocionantes que escuchar música en casa. (I listen to music every day. I love pop because it is lively and cheerful. I have been playing the guitar for four years. In my opinion, live concerts are more exciting than listening to music at home.)
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for music genres, instruments and concerts
Master desde hace + present tense for ongoing duration (not the perfect tense)
Build extended sentences combining opinions and comparatives with connectives

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — music and listening habits appear across all papers

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Me encanta el rock porque es más emocionante que la música clásica.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me encanta el rock = I love rock (notice: definite article el — Spanish requires it with general statements about music genres).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: porque es más emocionante que = because it is more exciting than. Más + adjective + que = the comparative structure.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I love rock because it is more exciting than classical music.

worked_examples.question: How do you say 'I have been playing the piano for five years' in Spanish?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: In Spanish, use the present tense for an action that started in the past and is still going on — NOT the perfect tense as in English.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Structure: verb (present) + desde hace + time. Tocar el piano → first person present = toco. Then add desde hace cinco años.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Toco el piano desde hace cinco años.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish music vocabulary to its English meaning
Match the Spanish adjectives and phrases to their English meaning

gaps.correct_explain: favorita is feminine because cantante here refers to a female singer. Adjectives ending in -o change to -a for feminine.

wrong.favorito: favorito is masculine. We are talking about a female singer, so the adjective must be feminine: favorita.

gaps.correct_explain: Suelo escuchar means 'I usually listen to'. After soler, you always use the infinitive.

wrong.escucho: escucho is the conjugated present tense. After suelo, you need the infinitive: escuchar.

gaps.correct_explain: más means 'more'. The structure is más + adjective + que to say 'more … than'.
que means 'than' in comparative structures. Más/menos ... que = more/less ... than.

wrong.de: de is used in superlatives (e.g. el mejor de), not in simple comparatives. Use que for 'than'.

bronze.question: What does 'Toco la guitarra desde hace tres años' mean?
options: I have been playing the guitar for three years
I played the guitar three years ago
I will play the guitar for three years
I started playing the guitar three years ago and then stopped

bronze.question: What does 'Me encantan los conciertos en directo' mean?

bronze.source_text: Escucho música pop todos los días porque es animada y alegre.
model_answers: I listen to pop music every day because it is lively and cheerful.

bronze.question: Listen and type what you hear

silver.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: que es el mejor género musical.

gaps.rule: desde hace + present for ongoing duration
gaps.correct_explain: desde is needed to form the ongoing-duration structure: verb (present) + desde hace + time.

wrong.para: para means 'for' in purpose contexts, not duration. Use desde hace for 'I have been doing X for Y time'.
wrong.por: por can mean 'for' in duration of a completed action (e.g. viví allí por dos años), but for an ongoing action use desde hace.

gaps.correct_explain: creo (I believe/think) is the first person present of creer. pienso (I think) and opino (I think/believe) are also correct.

wrong.cree: cree is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → creo.

silver.english: I have been listening to rap music **for** two years and I **think** it is the best music genre.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: He escuchado música clásica desde hace cinco años.
silver.error_type: Tense — desde hace requires present, not perfect
silver.explanation: In Spanish, desde hace (for — ongoing) is used with the present tense, not the perfect. He escuchado is the perfect tense — correct in English but wrong in Spanish. Use Escucho música clásica desde hace cinco años.
silver.translation: I have been listening to classical music for five years.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: I usually listen to rock music because it is exciting.

distractor_labels.escucho: wrong form — after suelo you need the infinitive escuchar, not the conjugated escucho

silver.source_text: I prefer pop music because it is more cheerful than rock.
model_answers: Prefiero la música pop porque es más alegre que el rock.

silver.question: Listen and type what you hear
silver.audio_text: Toco el piano desde hace cuatro años y me encanta.
silver.correct_text: Toco el piano desde hace cuatro años y me encanta.
silver.translation: I have been playing the piano for four years and I love it.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: I have been playing the guitar for six years and I think it is more interesting than the piano. Last summer I went to a live concert and it was amazing.
model_answers: Toco la guitarra desde hace seis años y creo que es más interesante que el piano. El verano pasado fui a un concierto en directo y fue increíble.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: In my opinion, live concerts are much better than streaming music at home.

distractor_labels.más buenos: irregular comparative — bueno has the irregular form mejor (better), not más bueno
distractor_labels.buen: wrong form — buen is the shortened form of bueno before a masculine singular noun; here you need the plural mejores

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in Spain that also hosts live music events. You want to find out about an upcoming concert.

bullets.prompt: Greet the receptionist and ask if there is a concert this weekend.
bullets.model_answer: ¡Buenos días! ¿Hay un concierto este fin de semana?
bullets.note: ¿Hay...? (is there...?) + este fin de semana (this weekend)

bullets.prompt: Say what type of music you prefer and give a reason.
bullets.model_answer: Prefiero la música pop porque es más animada que la música clásica.
bullets.note: prefiero (I prefer) + comparative más + adj + que

bullets.prompt: Ask the price of the tickets and whether there is a student discount.
bullets.model_answer: ¿Cuánto cuestan las entradas? ¿Hay descuento para estudiantes?
bullets.note: ¿cuánto cuestan? (how much do they cost?) + ¿hay descuento? (is there a discount?)

bullets.prompt: Say you have been playing the guitar for three years and you love going to concerts.
bullets.model_answer: Toco la guitarra desde hace tres años y me encanta ir a conciertos.
bullets.note: desde hace + present tense (toco, not he tocado) + me encanta ir a (I love going to)

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Escucho música pop desde hace cinco años porque es más relajante que el rock.
gold.correct_text: Escucho música pop desde hace cinco años porque es más relajante que el rock.
gold.translation: I have been listening to pop music for five years because it is more relaxing than rock.

gold.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: Creo que la música en directo es mejor
que las entradas son muy caras.

gaps.correct_explain: que means 'than' in comparative structures: mejor que = better than.

wrong.de: de is used in superlatives (el mejor de). In a simple comparative, use que.

gaps.rule: Concessive clause — though I acknowledge / I admit
gaps.correct_explain: reconozco (I acknowledge/admit) introduces a concessive point after aunque. admito (I admit) is also correct.

wrong.reconoce: reconoce is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → reconozco.

gold.english: I think live music is better **than** listening to it at home, although I **admit/acknowledge** that tickets are very expensive.
